body.objective: Add the smallest generic validated singular-endpoint initializer needed to turn exact vector Frobenius and irregular normal-form series into finite-radius interval basis boxes consumed by math/ivlinode.
body.stop_condition: Land a generic lib/math API with two fail-closed modes. REGULAR-SINGULAR mode accepts a parameter-interval rational matrix series for rho Y'=B(rho,p)Y, exact indicial data and compatible finite resonance witnesses; it returns outward enclosures for a normalized vector Frobenius basis and derivative at rational epsilon using a proved analytic majorant/tail inequality. IRREGULAR-RANK1 mode accepts a truncated exact normal form F_N=P_N D, its exact residual E_N=F_N'-A F_N, declared real-parameter rate/power weights and entrywise rational decay bounds for K_N=F_N^{-1}E_N; it verifies p_ij>1 and a Volterra contraction q<1, then returns an outward enclosure for F(R)=F_N(R)Z(R) and its derivative. Both modes must support interval parameter cells, exact compatible resonance heads, normalized phases equal to one at the initialization radius, derivative tails, basis-rank/conditioning checks through math/ivmat, explicit refusal codes and mutation tests. Gate a scalar regular-singular control plus the Phase-3 axial ell=2 real-frequency fixtures on omega in [1/2,3/4], initially epsilon=1/4 and R=32. A stricter subdivision/order replay must intersect and improve the result. The irregular fixture must reject a nonintegrable 1/r remainder, an underestimated remainder constant, a duplicated column and a frequency box crossing omega=0.
body.current_gate: Validated horizon and infinity initial boxes before the axial global connection pilot
body.forbid: no truncated series called an enclosure; no convergence claim for the Gevrey-1 infinity expansion; no floating tail constant without outward rounding; no silently ignored resonance; no point frequency called parameter-uniform; no singular endpoint embedded into ivlinode; no BVP, scattering, pole or stability promotion
body.resource_hint: Horizon: use inverse-pivot bounds after the finite resonant head and an analytic coefficient majorant. Infinity: the axial recurrences are Gevrey-1, so use a truncated normal form plus weighted Volterra correction; math/ivlinode remains only the finite nonsingular middle flow and math/ivmat supplies rank/solve gates.
notes: For a horizon branch a_n, a sufficient tail contract is q_H=S_B(tau)/(N+1-kappa)<1 with epsilon<tau below the nearest coefficient singularity; return function and derivative geometric-tail boxes, including the |s|/epsilon term.

For infinity set K_N=F_N^{-1}E_N and verify |K_ij|<=C_ij r^{-p_ij}, p_ij>1. The contraction q_inf=max_i sum_j C_ij R^(1-p_ij)/(p_ij-1)<1 implies ||Z(R)-I||_inf<=q_inf/(1-q_inf). Incorporate same-rate resonances into the normal form until every weighted remainder entry is integrable.
Real-frequency scope only. Complex upper-half-plane pole searches require a later exponential-dichotomy extension and are not part of this request.
